verdict.rationale: The story asks for managed Slurm or Kubernetes job scheduling, which is a fair axis for a cloud compute platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Modal offering either. Modal's own serverless fan-out ('no job orchestration to manage') and background batch spawning are a different, proprietary scheduling model. That is an adjacent feature, not managed Slurm or Kubernetes, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
